content:
**Glowing Kanawha Piranha** is a type of fish in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Gone Fission* update. 

A rare fish, this glowing variant of the Kanawha Piranha can be caught with Bait - Common, Bait - Improved and Bait - Superb. When eaten, it gives ten Rads and restores a total of 10 Hit Points over 25 seconds. It can alternatively be sold, displayed on a Curved Fish Display or Fish Display Plaque, or cooked into Fish Bits.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| | | **Built or Scrapped:** | | Fish Bits (2) | 

Can be caught from any fishing spot in The Forest.
